items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Every S4 acceptance item has a pinned test: path replacement at all listed sites, D8f name passing, preview exit-code gate, hand-off sentence at all dev_server sites, guard and snippet tests.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Each resolver snippet states empty output = built-in defaults and exit 2/3 = stop and show the message; no retry or fallback.

items.name: Security Basics

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Guard test has a planted-path red case, hooks.json case, reverse allowlist test; snippet test runs real subprocesses and checks exit 0, exit 2 and the sentinel.

items.name: Performance Basics
